name: Curious Companion
benefit: You can select a plant companion or vermin companion as your animal companion.
flavor: Heroes tend to pick up the oddest friends—birds of the sky and beasts of the wood. Your companions are strange even by these standards.
text:
Heroes tend to pick up the oddest friends—birds of the sky and beasts of the wood. Your companions are strange even by these standards.

**Prerequisites**: Animal companion class feature.

**Benefit**: You can select a plant companion or vermin companion as your animal companion.
